_help: Animal farming (js/features/ranch). Coordinates are world metres (the ranch sits east of the kiosk plaza, road from worldmap.js RANCH). barn/coop levels: w x d building size, cap = animals it houses, cost to upgrade to that level (gold + items: kayu from felling trees, batu). species: home = barn | coop | pet, price, max (0 = only limited by the building), product = item id (every = days between products, tool = item needed to collect it, null = picked up by hand from the nest), feed = item ids it eats (rumput from mowing, pakan_unggas from the shop, jagung from the farm), adultDays = days a baby needs to grow up, variants = coat colours. Affection: 0..1000 points = 0..10 hearts; product quality ⭐ = 1 + hearts/2 (minus 1 when health < 60), golden product chance at 10 hearts + full health.

levels.name: Kandang Besar
levels.desc: Kandang diperpanjang (8 hewan) + silo untuk menyimpan rumput.

levels.name: Kandang Mewah
levels.desc: 12 hewan, tempat pakan terisi otomatis dari silo tiap pagi, pemanas: hewan tidak sakit di musim dingin.

levels.name: Kandang Ayam Besar
levels.desc: 8 unggas + mesin tetas: masukkan telur, 3 hari kemudian menetas.

products.name: Telur Ayam
products.desc: Telur segar dari ayammu sendiri. Mentah bisa bikin mual.

products.name: Telur Bebek
products.desc: Telur bebek yang besar, cangkangnya kebiruan.

products.name: Susu Sapi
products.desc: Susu sapi segar. Mengenyangkan dan menghilangkan haus.

products.name: Susu Kambing
products.desc: Susu kambing yang kental dan bergizi.

products.name: Wol
products.desc: Bulu domba yang lembut. Bahan kain & benang.

goods.name: Pakan Unggas
goods.desc: Biji-bijian untuk ayam & bebek. Isi tempat pakan kandang ayam, atau beri langsung (G).

goods.name: Sikat Hewan
goods.desc: Sikat bulu hewan setiap hari (G di dekat hewan): hewan jadi lebih sayang.

goods.name: Pemerah Susu
goods.desc: Perah susu sapi & kambing (G di dekat hewan).

goods.name: Gunting Bulu
goods.desc: Cukur domba yang bulunya sudah lebat (G di dekat domba).

goods.name: Obat Ternak
goods.desc: Menyembuhkan hewan yang sakit (G di dekat hewan).

goods.name: Ramuan Kawin
goods.desc: Untuk sapi, kambing, domba, dan kuda dewasa yang sayang padamu (4 hati+). 5 hari kemudian lahir bayinya.
